# biznetgio_gpu_console (Data Source)

Akses console NEO GPU (`POST /neo-gpus/accounts/{account_id}/console-access`). Side-effecting: setiap pemanggilan bisa mint session/credential baru, jangan dipakai dalam plan diff.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_gpu_console" "main" {
  account_id = 12345
}

output "console_url" {
  value     = data.biznetgio_gpu_console.main.url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number) Account id GPU yang mau diakses consolenya.

### Read-Only

- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response.
- `url` (String) URL console (alias url/console_url/access_url/href).
